chunks: This is indeed the truth of certainty.
ai.seo_question: What does 'Haqq al-Yaqin' mean in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Al-Mursalat is often interpreted as the ultimate certainty of the Resurrection (Ma'ad), affirming the reality of the Hereafter beyond any doubt. It underscores the concept of 'Haqq al-Yaqin' as a state of knowledge that transforms belief into undeniable truth, a theme central to Shia theological discussions on the certainty of divine promises and prophecies.
